results.question: How can I order more books from InfoBooks?
results.expected_evidence: Answer only if the InfoBooks pages contain actionable ordering information; otherwise abstain
results.actual_answer: To order more books from InfoBooks, you can visit [1] and [4] to find the list of free PDF books available in various languages. You can also scan the code or go to [infobooks.org/free-pdf-books/] to access the books[2, 4]. Additionally, you can visit [infolibros.org/libro/manual-de-vida-epicteto/] for the Spanish version and [infolivros.org/livro/o-encheiridion-epicteto/] for the Portuguese version of the work by Epictetus[4].
